notes.title: Update (ver2.0.0 A Further Ending)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
This is tokoronyori
Thank you for playing Bokura: planet

I have released a new update featuring various additions, including an added ending.

Thanks to all your feedback and reactions, I came to feel that I needed to tell a little more of what lies ahead for the characters. Futures I had previously left up to the player’s imagination. 
By adding this new ending, I hope to create a point from which players can truly imagine what could happen.
Please see where their journey leads, and if possible, I hope you’ll talk about what you believe their future holds.

In addition, I have also addressed several progression-stopping bugs that were reported on the forum, along with a few gameplay adjustments.

ーーーーー

ver. 2.0.0

・An additional ending
A new further ending has been added. Corresponding achievements have also been added.

・Fixes for certain connectivity issues
Addressed issues related to server disconnection, lag, and forced game termination.

・Some puzzles have been rebalanced.

・Fixed achievement unlock bug
Fixed an issue where achievements were not unlocking even after meeting the conditions. If you had already met the conditions in a previous playthrough, simply launch the updated game, and the achievement will automatically unlock on the home screen.

・Other minor bug fixes

－－－－－

Due to how the game is built, the game has to be played between the same versions.
If two different versions are connected, the host will receive an error message,
“App version mismatch. Update to latest version”
If this appears, please enable Steam auto-update and restart Steam before playing the game.

I hope you continue to enjoy the game.

notes.title: BOKURA: planet – Thank You Regarding the Launch & Upcoming Update Plans
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Tokoronyori.

First of all, thank you so much for playing BOKURA: planet. It’s hard to believe it’s already been a week since launch, and we’ve been overwhelmed by the response on Steam, social media, and across various communities. I’m truly delighted that this project has found its way into your hands.
Based on your feedback, I’m currently considering the following updates:

1. Additional Ending for BOKURA: planet
It was an incredible feeling to see so many of you dive into BOKURA: planet faster than even BOKURA’s launch momentum and share your thoughts on the story. I’ve been touched by analyses and theories I never even imagined, and as the creator, it’s a daily joy to see this work resonate with you. In response, I want to craft a new ending that lets you ponder the characters’ futures—just as we did after BOKURA. While the plot is still in broad-strokes planning, I’m aiming to implement it in-game sometime between May and June.

2. Connection-Issue Countermeasures
We’ve seen reports—especially in Simplified Chinese reviews and community threads—of lag and occasional crashes due to server connection hiccups. I’ll be running validation tests and server diagnostics to pinpoint what we can improve, then roll those fixes into an upcoming update.

3. Puzzle-Difficulty Adjustments
Some of you pointed out that a few puzzles feel overly cryptic. I’ll be reviewing and rebalancing their overall difficulty to ensure a smoother experience.

4. Other Bugs & Feedback Handling
Beyond the items above, I’m combing through every piece of feedback you’ve posted. If you encounter any bugs while playing, please report them in this thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3126150/discussions/0/598524944980131032/

I read every report and will patch issues as they come up.

________________________________________

About BOKURA: planet
This project grew out of ideas I had during the planning of BOKURA, but with a twist: whereas the original focused on “the different landscapes each player sees,” BOKURA: planet explores “what each player is thinking in their heart.” 
You and your partner must cooperate toward your own hidden goals, creating the paradox of feeling lonely even while standing side by side. 
In moments where thorough communication and mutual understanding are crucial, tensions may arise—but that very tension, and the process of working through it together, completes the experience.
After you finish playing, I hope you’ll ask yourselves: What changed between the two of you? What stayed the same? And above all, what lies beyond confronting that sense of loneliness? It’s in those questions—and your conversations afterward—that BOKURA: planet truly comes to life.

Thank you again for your support, and please look forward to what’s next!
